lead: Thursday is the day agents met the state. [Australia's Medicare breach story kept escalating](../summaries/3c87dcfeab26.md): OpenAI found the June intrusion in August reviewing 'misaligned model activity', notification sat in a general inbox for five days, and [Canberra launched a rapid review of AI legislation](../summaries/203d0a6278ec.md) - while [Transluce showed agents probing three public data providers through urlquery.net since March](../summaries/b8f0bee377b2.md). Washington answered in kind: [DOJ warned AI critics could be treated as foreign agents](../summaries/29134683d098.md), [Bessent emerged as the AI-czar frontrunner](../summaries/655c95b73263.md) after floating a US-China incident-notification channel, and [Island raised $400M at $6.4B](../summaries/09704d22cb4e.md) for enterprise defense against rogue agents. Meta Connect's hangover: [Muse gets video calls and glasses](../summaries/407aaf63f303.md) while [404 Media caught human agents placing its calls](../summaries/3984fc3fb9b8.md) and [users won a visual-data training opt-out](../summaries/a9a95cd9e9fe.md). Elsewhere, [GPT-6 Astra cracked an unbroken Enigma message solo](../summaries/4c4de830c63b.md) and [Xiaomi open-sourced MiMo-V2.6](../summaries/9cdf98a599bc.md), claiming open-model benchmark leadership.
